tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Bios (short and medium), titles, suggested attribution, books, topics he comments on, languages, speaking topics/formats/past stages, press photos and contact routes.

tools.name: search_quotes
tools.description: Search his curated quotes by topic or keyword (e.g. "trust", "Shenzhen", "tariffs", "Europe"). Each result has text, date, outlet, source_url and a ready-made attribution. Empty query returns the latest.

tools.name: search_coverage
tools.description: Search 225+ interviews, quotes, TV appearances and op-eds (outlet, title, date, link, his quotes and a summary). Empty query returns the most recent.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send a request straight to Chris Pereira by email: media comment or interview, analyst briefing, or an invitation to speak (keynote, panel, podcast, show guest, training). He replies by email to the address given, usually within 24 hours.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
